selection_reasoning: The task 'find lavafall' is a visually striking, observable, and verifiable task that requires the agent to navigate and explore a Minecraft environment to locate a lavafall (lava flowing down from a height, similar to a waterfall but with lava). This task is self-contained as a single atomic task, doesn't require deep crafting knowledge, and is easily verifiable by checking if the agent is near flowing lava blocks. It provides a good exploration challenge and the scene can be designed to make it interesting without being trivially easy.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate toward the lavafall and face it to confirm visual identification. Target [12, 0, 10] is the ground-level base of the lavafall (spawn-relative), where lava pools after flowing down the 12-block stone cliff face. max_distance=10 requires the player to walk at least ~5-6 blocks from spawn (total distance from spawn to target is ~15.6 blocks), ensuring meaningful navigation rather than trivial completion. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the lavafall, not just standing nearby facing away.

scene_description: A 12-block-high stone cliff located ~12 blocks from spawn with lava source blocks at the top that flow down the front face, creating a lavafall. The player spawns on flat grass and must navigate toward the stone cliff to find the lavafall. Fire resistance is applied to prevent accidental death. Fire tick is disabled to prevent terrain damage.
task_text: Find the lavafall - a stream of lava flowing down from a tall stone cliff. Navigate toward it and get close enough to observe it clearly.
design_notes: The lavafall is created by placing 4 lava source blocks at y=12 on the front face of a stone cliff (x=11-14, z=10). An air channel from y=0 to y=11 at z=10 allows the lava to flow downward. The stone cliff extends from x=10-16, z=10-16, height 0-12. A stone basin at z=8-9 catches any lava that flows to ground level. The player spawns at [0,0,0] relative on grass and must walk ~12 blocks toward the cliff. Fire resistance prevents damage, fire tick is disabled to prevent terrain fires. The lavafall is visible from spawn (the orange glow at the top of the cliff is apparent) but the player must approach to clearly observe it.
